escalation_note: Two low-coverage rule probes (one per schedule) to measure the amount-column text lines, then four 900 dpi raster crops as the geometry spot-verification: p3 rows 1 and 8 (reproduce 500.00 and 2,000.00) and p4 rows 5 and 14 (reproduce 36.99 and 116.00). No legibility escalation was needed on the schedules - they are cleanly typed; the handwriting on this filing is confined to the cover and to one purpose cell (p4 line 13).

3.measure_note: The 2026 schedules are typed SPREADSHEET prints with no printed rules at all, so there is no grid for rowbands to find. The bands are measured from the page's own printed AMOUNT lines: a dark-run probe restricted to the amount-column x-window returns one run per printed entry line, and the independent COUNT of those runs matches the number of transcribed rows exactly. Each band is that measured centre +/- 1.00 pct. Every entry occupies two printed lines (name, then city/state) but only the first carries the amount, which is the line banded here. On p3 the probe (x window 56-68 pct) returns exactly 8 entry lines at 22.59 / 26.48 / 30.30 / 34.07 / 37.80 / 41.59 / 45.36 / 49.05 pct on a constant ~3.78 pct pitch; 18.70 is the 'Amount' column header and 56.48 the TOTAL line, both excluded. PROVED with 900 dpi crops at rows 1 (500.00) and 8 (2,000.00).
